name: The Paper Boat River of Wishes
description: A river where thousands of origami paper boats carry written wishes downstream, each boat glowing softly and leaving trails of light behind.
prompt: A serene river at twilight where thousands of delicate origami paper boats drift peacefully downstream, each carrying handwritten wishes that glow with soft golden light. The boats leave trails of sparkling stardust in the water, creating a path of dreams leading to a distant castle made of crystallized hope. Cherry blossom trees line the banks, their petals falling like confetti onto the water's surface. Children watch from the shore, holding their own wish papers ready to launch. Peaceful atmosphere, warm and cool color contrast, fantasy realism.
caption: Every wish needs a journey - let yours sail on the river of dreams... 🚤✨
